subject: Conditional payment rail and tax-flow playbook for ViroHealth POC
messages:
From: David Rossi <david.rossi@virohealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@virohealth.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Payment rail and VAT handling for ViroHealth POC

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed. Procurement has asked me to get clarity on payment terms and tax flow before we move forward with the pilot SOW. High level asks from finance:

- Can Redwood support Net60 on the final invoice? We typically operate Net45/Net60 for new vendors for enterprise pilots.
- We need a clear VAT flow: ViroHealth is VAT-registered in DE (DE VAT ID attached) — we need confirmation on invoicing (gross invoice vs reverse-charge) and any supporting documents Redwood needs on file (certificate of residency, fiscal representative, etc.).
- We also want to understand credit limits / prepayment options in case we need to ramp usage quickly.

Suggested payment structure from our side (flexible): 30% signing, 40% after pilot acceptance, 30% Net60 final. If you have a templated alternative that manages risk for both sides, please share.

Can you also share SOC2 and a statement of data residency for EU customers (we have an internal checklist to close)? Attaching our standard vendor questionnaire for reference.

Appreciate a proposed playbook — dates are soft but we’re targeting kickoff in late August.

Best,
David
VP, Finance Operations
ViroHealth

Attachments: vendor_questions.pdf
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: David Rossi <david.rossi@virohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Payment rail and VAT handling for ViroHealth POC

David — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the questionnaire. Looping in Finance (Karthik) and Legal ops (Laura) to help.

High level response / proposed conditional playbook:

1) Payment schedule (provisional, negotiable):
   - 40% due on SOW signature (invoice raised immediately)
   - 30% due on pilot acceptance (milestone invoice)
   - 30% final tranche — Redwood can agree to Net45 by default, or Net60 as a one-off if ViroHealth provides a credit application + financials and accepts a small credit fee offset (see below).

2) Credit and limits:
   - Standard starting credit limit for new enterprise pilots: EUR 150,000.
   - If you require Net60 on final tranche without credit application, we would need executive approval and a temporary holdback policy (e.g., release 70% of final tranche on invoice, hold 30% until payment or go-live acceptance).

3) VAT / tax flow:
   - For EU B2B with a valid VAT ID, Redwood typically issues an invoice gross with reverse-charge indicated (no VAT) when the buyer provides VAT evidence.
   - Please upload proof of VAT registration (certificate or VAT ID screenshot) and confirm billing entity and legal address. If ViroHealth needs us to gross-up VAT instead, we can accommodate but need tax rep details.

4) Evidence & compliance:
   - SOC2 Type II, EU data residency statement, and DPA in our standard MSA. Attaching a draft MSA + SOW for internal review.

Next steps: Karthik — can you run a provisional credit check and confirm whether we can offer Net60 as requested or propose the holdback? Laura — can you flag any legal concerns on the draft MSA for VAT language. David — if you can confirm VAT ID (and attach certificate) and share the top-line financials for credit, we’ll fast-track this.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call today or tomorrow if that helps.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_draft_msa_virohealth.pdf, sow_v1.2.pdf
On Wed, 12 Aug 2026 at 08:27 David Rossi <david.rossi@virohealth.com> wrote:
From: David Rossi <david.rossi@virohealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@virohealth.com
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 08:27:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Payment rail and VAT handling for ViroHealth POC

Monica / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from procurement after reviewing your proposed playbook: 

- We can accept the 40/30/30 split but would prefer Net60 on the final tranche (Net60 on the 30%) — given internal approval timelines that’s easier for treasury.
- If Redwood wants to keep Net45 internally, we are open to an escrow holdback: Redwood invoices Net60 but ViroHealth authorizes an escrowed payment that releases to Redwood on 15-day acceptance signoff; escrow managed by an agreed provider. That reduces credit exposure on both sides.
- SOC2 + EU residency: we’ve received SOC2 from your portal earlier but need an explicit statement confirming EU-only data for this pilot (no US processing).
- VAT: attached DE VAT registration PDF. We prefer reverse-charge treatment; please include the reverse-charge note on the invoice.

Attaching our vendor questionnaire (filled partially) and the VAT doc. Happy to sign a credit application to support Net60 if required.

Regards,
David

Attachments: vendor_questions.pdf (updated), DE_VAT_certificate.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: David Rossi <david.rossi@virohealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 15:40:00 +0000
Subject: Final proposed commercial terms — ViroHealth POC (credit & VAT)

David / Monica / team — following the internal review and a light credit check, finance can support the following conditional terms:

1) Payment schedule (final):
   - 40% invoice on signature, due on receipt (standard)
   - 30% invoice on pilot acceptance, Net30
   - 30% final tranche: Redwood will accept Net45 for the final tranche subject to either:
       a) ViroHealth completes and returns the credit application (viro_credit_application.xlsx) with latest 2 quarters P&L / balance summary, OR
       b) ViroHealth agrees to the escrow holdback model: invoice remains Net60 but 70% of the final tranche is released to Redwood on invoicing, 30% is held in escrow until acceptance or 45 days, whichever is earlier.

2) Credit limit and fees:
   - Provisional starting credit limit: EUR 150,000.
   - If ViroHealth requires unconditional Net60 on final tranche without a credit application, we would apply a 1.5% short-term credit fee on the final tranche (one-time).

3) VAT
   - We will apply reverse-charge (no VAT charged) on EU B2B invoices upon receipt of validated VAT registration (we received your DE certificate). Please confirm the billing legal entity and the invoicing address exactly as it should appear on the invoice.

4) Compliance evidence:
   - SOC2 Type II and DPA references: see link to portal below (we will include explicit EU residency clause for this engagement).

Attachments sent: viro_credit_application.xlsx, updated SOW (sow_v1.2.pdf). Please countersign the SOW and return the credit pack if you want the Net45 concession; otherwise toggle to escrow option and let us know the escrow provider details so we can prepare MSA addendum.

Next steps: David — please confirm which path (credit pack vs escrow) you prefer. Laura will send the VAT wording update to the MSA for signature. Monica — happy to schedule a 20-min call to close this out.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
